schema.name: port-factory-state
schema.description: Machine-readable state for the private X_ITE 16.5.0 -> Rust port factory. Plain JSON, no tool-specific format. Gap authority is the REA ledger (ledger_path); this file only tracks factory progress. Written only by .port-factory/tools/{sync,next,record}.py.

fields.counts: ledger status counts (COMPLETE, PARTIAL, MISSING, DIFFERENT, NOT_TESTED) and total; only COMPLETE counts toward coverage
fields.active: task currently being worked: {id, started, attempts, status_at_start, missing} or null
fields.test_results: [{id, time, verdict PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, kind focused|integration, command, evidence, note}] newest last
fields.blockers: [{id, date, note, resolved}]; a BLOCKED oracle is not a pass
fields.backlog_top: top 20 of the ranked open backlog (see backlog.md for the full list)
